scopeBoundary: Content and source verification only. No training, inference, dataset download, checkpoint execution, Git operation, email, or production independentReview metadata write was performed.

authorEvidenceUse.note: Author evidence was used to locate sources and suspected claims. Every retained conclusion below was independently checked against reopened official sources or fixed primary-source caches.

papers.publicationStatus: arXiv:2609.37098v2 preprint; the Elsevier manuscript template is not publication evidence.

metadataCheck.authors: Nine authors matched the official HTML and PDF first page.
metadataCheck.affiliations: All seven institutions in frontmatter matched the official PDF first page.

actualSourceReads.read: Title/authors/affiliations; sections 3.1-3.5; equations 7-8, 33-34, 36-38 and training objective boundaries; sections 4.1-4.5; tables 1-4; conclusion.
UniV2X formal AAAI 2025 status and sparse-dense cooperative mechanism.
UniV2X query/probability-map transmission, temporal/spatial alignment, fusion and planning interfaces.
UniMM-V2X perception/prediction query fusion and MoE placement in BEV encoder and motion decoder.

claimChecks.worldActionBoundary: The report correctly distinguishes the internal action-to-world-to-action feature loop from environment interaction after ego action execution. The log future is the sole supervised future; no counterfactual interactive-world evidence is claimed.
claimChecks.communicationBoundary: 12x64x64 INT8 values plus twelve channel scales equal 49,200 bytes per message and 98,400 B/s at 2 Hz. This is analytical message payload, not measured wireless throughput; protocol headers, retransmission, queueing and air-interface scheduling remain excluded.
claimChecks.numbers: Tables 2-4, all retained horizon/average values, units and directions matched. Derived 0.52 m, 34.9%, 0.11 percentage points, 89.4%, 2.46 percentage points and 0.02 m were recomputed.
claimChecks.formulas: Symbols and stop-gradient boundaries in the retained quantization, occupancy transport and bounded refinement equations matched the primary text.
claimChecks.limitations: The report does not turn unmeasured closed-loop, latency, packet-loss or generalization behavior into observed failure.

figures.observation: Reliability-aware dual-agent encoding and quantized message occupy the upper path; Top-1 action conditions the world decoder and world features return once to trajectory refinement in the lower path.
Two road-aligned examples compare a muted RSU message with full cooperation while holding the preliminary plan/action fixed; red contours are ground truth and the plots are qualitative cases.

resources.weights: No V2X-WAM checkpoint was verified as downloadable.

papers.publicationStatus: arXiv:2610.01750v1 preprint; official PDF says ICLR 2027 under review, so it is not recorded as accepted.

metadataCheck.authors: Haoxin Wu and Xiaokai Bai matched the official HTML and PDF first page.
metadataCheck.affiliations: College of Information Science and Electronic Engineering, Zhejiang University matched the official PDF first page.

actualSourceReads.read: Sections 3.2-3.5 and 4; equations 9, 14-17 and 20; printed tables 1-6 and 14; appendices E-H. The HTML merges printed tables 3-6 under anchor S4.T6, so each claim was checked against its printed table title rather than the shared anchor label.
SparseCoop explicit kinematic state, spatiotemporal alignment, matched/unmatched instance handling and ego-image refinement.
CodeFilling CVPR 2024 accepted-version watermark, information-demand selection and shared-codebook integer-index transmission.

claimChecks.identityBoundary: The report correctly separates CSA admission, URA refinement and post-decoding CPIA identity binding. Map-only, Association-only and Full are not conflated, and fixed-checkpoint interventions are distinguished from retrained URA variants.
claimChecks.identityNumbers: Table 2 and table 14 values matched, including 50.4 to 60.1 AMOTA and 116 to 69 IDS under Hungarian allocation plus CPIA, and fixed-checkpoint Map-only 60.5, Association-only 32.5, Full 61.1 AMOTA.
claimChecks.compressionBoundary: The complete query payload is accounted for: 52 bytes of state/confidence/source ID, 1,024 bytes for an uncompressed 256-float feature, and 53/54 bytes for one-/two-byte code indices. Packet headers and one-time codebook synchronization are excluded from steady-state B/s.
claimChecks.compressionNumbers: Printed table 6 matched: 172,000 B/s, 54.9 AP, 61.2 AMOTA, 49 IDS uncompressed versus 8,480 B/s, 54.8 AP, 61.1 AMOTA, 70 IDS for the 256-codeword setting. The report correctly retains the 21-switch increase.
claimChecks.robustnessBoundary: Yaw and simulated-delay tests use fixed checkpoints and do not establish real-network queueing or packet-loss performance.
claimChecks.limitations: The report does not claim downstream planning benefit from IDS, zero synchronization cost, or real-world radio throughput.

figures.observation: The figure shows camera feature extraction, codebook communication, latency/coordinate alignment, then CSA to URA to CPIA; the right-side BEV is output visualization rather than LiDAR input.
Five consecutive frames compare Full on the top pair of rows with Sticky FFBL-Coop on the bottom pair. This is not a SparseCoop comparison.

actualSourceReads.read: Sections 3-4; equations and Claim 1; printed tables 1-5; appendices B, D, E and F, including exact Stop/Go eligibility windows and computational resources.
Official project page method, ground-truth replay boundary, tables and visible download links. No implementation link was present.
DiLu vector-database experience retrieval, few-shot prompting and reflection-based memory updates.
COMPACT-VA current arXiv comments state RA-L 2026 acceptance; no formal DOI was found in the report's check window.
COMPACT-VA Q-former/hierarchical FIFO, posterior future-trajectory supervision and prior-only inference path.

claimChecks.loopBoundary: Da Capo is correctly described as closed over self-generated memory while control observations and ego history are replayed from ground truth. No environment response to executed ego actions is claimed.
claimChecks.rewardAndFormulaBoundary: The 64-point 6.4-second imitation reward, causal return split, K=12 training/K=6 evaluation, and the no-standard-deviation scope of Claim 1 matched the primary source.
claimChecks.numbers: Tables 1-4 and retained derived changes matched. The reported compute budget also matched: eight 80 GB H100s for SFT and four identical eight-GPU nodes, 32 H100s total, for RL over roughly two to three days.
claimChecks.limitations: The report retains the high training budget, lack of interactive control, missing action-expert experiment and unmatched vector-memory baseline instead of presenting them as observed failures.

resolvedDuringRound.finding: The prior line 110 incorrectly described both Stop SR and Go SR as using symmetric 0.7-second tolerance.
resolvedDuringRound.primaryEvidence: https://arxiv.org/html/2609.38641v1#A2.SS1, equations 19-20: Stop SR permits 2*epsilon_stop early and epsilon_stop late with epsilon_stop=0.7 s; Go SR uses 0.7 s on each side, plus the remain-stopped case.
resolvedDuringRound.result: Corrected line 110 now states Stop early 1.4 s/late 0.7 s, Go early/late 0.7 s, and the full-horizon remain-stopped condition.

figures.observation: The image shows the left-car arrival event retained in language memory and three illustrated uses: driving, scene VQA and portable notes.
Parallel memory rollouts receive trajectory-wise memory/answer advantages while driving tokens are compared stepwise; no environment-action feedback images are shown.

papers.reviewScope: Independent v1-to-v2 delta verification plus link and retained-figure regression. The previously reviewed unchanged report body was not re-adjudicated from scratch.

actualSourceReads.read: Complete deterministic v1-to-v2 text diff; changed table 3, table 6, table 8 and associated result prose; newly exposed affiliation list; all v2 fragments used by the report.
README, repository scope, nuScenes-only open-loop release, code/config/data instructions and checkpoint metadata.
Current public config has total batch 12, four GPUs, 10 epochs and base learning rate 3e-6; it remains distinct from the manuscript's eight-RTX-4090, batch-48, 20-epoch protocol.
StableDrive remains a 2026 preprint; its one-cycle enhanced-query cache, selective SSM, training-only scaffold and midpoint-checkpoint construction were distinguished from MomADv2.

deltaChecks.reportedChanges: NC 99.0 to 98.7; DAC 97.1 to 96.8; TTC 95.5 to 95.4; EP 83.2 to 84.5; Comfort remains 100; PDMS remains 89.9.
deltaChecks.sourceLocations: The same corrected values appear in v2 printed tables 3, 6 and 8 and the NAVSIM-v1 result paragraph.
deltaChecks.interpretation: The report correctly avoids inferring whether the correction was transcription or reevaluation and does not label the lower/higher components as measured algorithm regression/improvement.
deltaChecks.otherChanges: The deterministic diff also adds the eight affiliation lines and citation rendering changes; no method change or other retained report number change was found.

The readable PDF extraction shows perception, reliable historical-query selection, selective state-space update, training-only GT flow supervision, gated residual inference and long-horizon output.
Four NAVSIM columns compare GuideFlow above with MomADv2 below; they are qualitative trajectory cases and do not show within-segment environment feedback.

reviewSummary.evidenceBoundary: PASS means the current report text is supported by the reopened primary sources within this review scope. It is not experiment reproduction, deployment validation, or approval of a research idea.
